title: Unified Approach for Weakly Supervised Multicalibration
abstract: arXiv:2605.09857v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multicalibration requires predicted scores to agree with label probabilities across rich families of subgroups and score-dependent tests, but existing methods require clean input-label pairs for evaluation and post-processing. This assumption fails in weakly supervised learning (WSL) regimes -- including positive-unlabeled, unlabeled-unlabeled, and positive-confidence learning -- where clean labels are costly or unavailable even though reliable uncertainty estimates may be crucial. We address this gap by developing estimators of multicalibration error and post-hoc correction methods for WSL settings in which clean input-label pairs are unavailable. We propose a unified framework for estimating and correcting multicalibration under weak supervision by combining contamination-matrix risk rewrites with witness-based calibration constraints, yielding corrected multicalibration moments with finite-sample guarantees. translated_title: 弱监督多校准的统一方法
translated_abstract: 多校准要求预测分数在丰富的子群族和分数相关测试中与标签概率保持一致，但现有方法需要干净的输入-标签对来进行评估和后处理。这一假设在弱监督学习（WSL）场景中并不成立——包括正例-未标注学习、未标注-未标注学习和正例-置信度学习——在这些场景中，干净标签的获取成本高昂或根本不可得，而可靠的不确定性估计却可能至关重要。我们通过为无法获得干净输入-标签对的弱监督设置开发多校准误差估计器和事后校正方法来填补这一空白。我们提出了一个在弱监督下估计和校正多校准的统一框架，该框架将污染矩阵风险重写与基于见证的校准约束相结合，从而得到具有有限样本保证的校正后多校准矩。我们进一步提出……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过将污染矩阵风险重写与基于见证的校准约束相结合，为缺乏干净标签的弱监督学习场景（如正例-未标注学习等）提供多校准误差估计与事后校正方法，并具有有限样本保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework combining contamination-matrix risk rewrites with witness-based calibration constraints to estimate and correct multicalibration in weakly supervised learning settings where clean input-label pairs are unavailable, with finite-sample guarantees.
